self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Ever-Changing: Using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by 40% for 5s.

en.flavor: A songbook from the bygone aristocratic era, whose composer has become forgotten. It chronicles the tale of a certain heroic outlaw.

refinements.1: Hitting an opponent with a Normal Attack decreases the Stamina consumption of Sprint or Alternate Sprint by <r>14%</r> for 5s. Additionally, using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by <r>20%</r> for 5s.
refinements.2: Hitting an opponent with a Normal Attack decreases the Stamina consumption of Sprint or Alternate Sprint by <r>16%</r> for 5s. Additionally, using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by <r>25%</r> for 5s.
refinements.3: Hitting an opponent with a Normal Attack decreases the Stamina consumption of Sprint or Alternate Sprint by <r>18%</r> for 5s. Additionally, using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by <r>30%</r> for 5s.
refinements.4: Hitting an opponent with a Normal Attack decreases the Stamina consumption of Sprint or Alternate Sprint by <r>20%</r> for 5s. Additionally, using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by <r>35%</r> for 5s.
refinements.5: Hitting an opponent with a Normal Attack decreases the Stamina consumption of Sprint or Alternate Sprint by <r>22%</r> for 5s. Additionally, using a Sprint or Alternate Sprint ability increases ATK by <r>40%</r> for 5s.

fr.flavor: Un recueil de chansons de l'époque aristocratique dont le compositeur est tombé dans l'oubli. Certaines d'entre elles relatent l'histoire d'un certain brigand héroïque...

refinements.1: Lorsqu'une attaque normale a touché un ennemi, la consommation d'endurance du sprint ou du sprint alternatif diminue de <r>14 %</r> pendant 5 s. De plus, après l'utilisation du sprint ou de l'aptitude qui le remplace, l'ATQ augmente de <r>20 %</r> pendant 5 s.
